name: Smart Speed Cache Accelerator™
author: jolizzie

sections.description:
Smart Speed Cache Accelerator™ is a WordPress and WooCommerce performance optimization plugin that brings caching, image delivery, CSS, JavaScript, fonts, WooCommerce safeguards, and performance diagnostics together in one easy-to-use dashboard.

Cache Faster. Optimize Smarter. Improve WordPress Performance.

A slow WordPress website can be affected by many things at once: page generation, large images, render-blocking CSS, unnecessary scripts, fonts, third-party resources, and heavy plugins. Smart Speed Cache Accelerator™ provides practical tools to work on those problems instead of only reporting that they exist.

The plugin uses clearly labeled optimization sections, Recommended ON/OFF guidance, conservative defaults, and built-in WooCommerce protections so website owners can improve performance without blindly applying aggressive changes.

Video Tutorial

See Smart Speed Cache Accelerator™ in action and take a guided tour of the caching, image, CSS, JavaScript, WooCommerce, diagnostic, and performance tools.

Watch on YouTube:
https://youtu.be/zrDFyxMu5p0

Smart Cache Engine™

Features include:

  • Page caching
  • Adjustable cache lifetime
  • Cache clearing and cache testing
  • Automatic cache invalidation
  • Content-update cache clearing
  • WooCommerce-aware cache handling
  • Logged-in user protection
  • Query-string controls
  • 404 cache controls
  • Custom cache exclusions
  • Cache hit and miss statistics
  • Cache size and last-build information

Smart Cache Status™

The dashboard shows useful cache information including cache working status, pages cached, cache size, cache hits, cache misses, last cache build, and active optimizations.

Quick Actions make it easy to Clear Cache or Test Cache Now directly from the dashboard.

Smart Responsive Image Delivery

Improve how existing WordPress responsive images are delivered without automatically replacing Media Library originals.

Features include:

  • Responsive image delivery using existing WordPress image candidates
  • WordPress srcset support
  • Smarter image sizes guidance
  • WooCommerce product-grid image sizing
  • LCP and hero responsive delivery
  • Image lazy loading
  • Iframe lazy loading
  • Missing width and height improvements
  • Above-the-fold image protection
  • LCP image prioritization
  • Fetch priority support

Optimize Large Images™

Review unusually large images before deciding whether to optimize them. Nothing is optimized simply because it was detected.

Selected supported images can be resized to a maximum of 1600×1600 and recompressed. Before optimization, Smart Speed saves a downloadable snapshot of the original image for additional safety.

Smart Asset Delivery™

Optimize eligible local CSS and shared front-end assets without combining everything into one oversized file.

Smart Asset Delivery™ can:

  • Cache and minify eligible local CSS
  • Create reusable optimized CSS copies
  • Preserve relative image and font paths
  • Remove exact duplicate CSS requests
  • Remove exact duplicate JavaScript requests
  • Detect useful external asset origins
  • Add useful external preconnect hints
  • Avoid redundant same-origin preconnect hints

Dynamic CSS, imported styles, admin/editor assets, and configured exclusions remain protected.

Safe Render-Blocking Controls™

Use a conservative CSS delivery system to defer only styles classified as low-risk and non-critical while keeping important styling in the normal render path.

Built-in protections cover important areas such as:

  • Theme layout and navigation
  • Headers
  • WooCommerce core styling
  • Product pages
  • Cart and checkout
  • Customer accounts
  • Payment gateways
  • Product galleries and variations
  • Ratings
  • jQuery and WooCommerce core behavior

JavaScript Optimization

Reduce JavaScript work during the initial page load with conservative controls and built-in protections for important WordPress and WooCommerce functionality.

Protected areas include jQuery, WooCommerce cart and checkout behavior, account and AJAX functions, payment gateways, forms, galleries, variations, and other critical shopping scripts.

Font & Front-End Optimization™

Improve text rendering and remove optional WordPress front-end resources when appropriate.

Controls include:

  • Optimize font loading
  • font-display: swap
  • Optimize external font connections
  • Remove WordPress emoji scripts
  • Remove WordPress embed scripts

WooCommerce Performance Optimization™

Reduce specifically identified non-critical WooCommerce product-page assets while protecting visible payment controls and essential shopping behavior.

Smart Speed can remove known unused payment and express-checkout assets on product pages only when no matching visible express-payment control is present.

Cart, checkout, account, Add to Cart, galleries, variations, AJAX, and visible payment controls remain protected.

WooCommerce Above-the-Fold Optimization™

Prioritize important WooCommerce product-page content for faster rendering while preserving the theme, product layout, and shopping controls.

Controls include:

  • Prioritize product title
  • Prioritize product price
  • Protect Add to Cart layout
  • Protect rating stars
  • Optional compact breadcrumbs for LCP testing
  • Conservative above-the-fold detection
  • Safe critical CSS generation for detected structural components

Critical CSS is intentionally conservative and does not copy or override theme colors, typography, WooCommerce grid sizing, or visual design.

Built-in WooCommerce Protections

Smart Speed Cache Accelerator™ is designed to avoid treating an online store like a static website.

Built-in safeguards help protect:

  • Add to Cart
  • Cart fragments
  • Cart and checkout
  • My Account
  • WooCommerce AJAX
  • Payment gateways
  • Product galleries
  • Product variations
  • Rating and review layouts
  • Navigation and header styling
  • Critical WooCommerce scripts and styles

Smart Speed Quick Wins™

Review practical performance opportunities without turning diagnostic information into made-up speed scores.

Tools include:

  • Optimize Large Images™
  • Review Inactive Plugins™
  • Heavy Plugin Analyzer™
  • Image and plugin review information

Nothing is deleted automatically. You choose which supported images to optimize and which inactive plugins, if any, to remove.

Heavy Plugin Analyzer™

Review the installed file size of active plugins that may deserve a closer performance check.

Installed plugin size alone does not mean a plugin is slowing down a website, so the report is presented as a review tool rather than a speed ranking.

Original Image Snapshot Protection

When supported large images are optimized, Smart Speed can save a downloadable copy of the original first. Snapshot files provide an additional recovery option and are not used to silently replace your live images.

Export Center™

Export useful information for later review, including:

  • Performance Report CSV
  • Cache Statistics CSV

PageSpeed & LCP Helpers

Smart Speed includes practical guidance and tools for common Google PageSpeed situations.

  • Smart PageSpeed Tester™ opens a public Google PageSpeed test for your homepage.
  • Breadcrumb LCP guidance helps when WooCommerce breadcrumbs are reported as the Largest Contentful Paint element.
  • Logo LCP Helper™ can create safe downloadable desktop and mobile logo copies from the current WordPress custom logo.
  • Generated logo copies are never automatically uploaded or substituted for the live logo.

Recommended Settings Without the Guesswork

Optimization groups explain what each control does and identify recommended, optional, or advanced settings where appropriate.

The dashboard includes Apply Recommended Settings, Save Settings, and Restore Recommended Settings controls so users have a sensible starting point while retaining individual control.

Lightweight by Design

Smart Speed Cache Accelerator™ is built around targeted optimization rather than adding unnecessary front-end libraries.

  • No unnecessary frontend libraries
  • Admin-focused dashboard assets
  • Targeted cache invalidation
  • Reusable optimized asset files
  • Conservative CSS handling
  • Controlled JavaScript optimization
  • WordPress-native responsive image support
  • WooCommerce protections
  • No fake performance scores
  • No made-up optimization statistics

Upgrade to PRO

Smart Speed Cache Accelerator PRO™ expands the performance toolkit with additional advanced optimization and performance features for users who want deeper control.

Learn more:
https://smartproductseo.com/product/smart-speed-cache-accelerator-pro-website-performance/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/smart-speed-cache-accelerator/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate Smart Speed Cache Accelerator™.
  3. Open Speed Cache in the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Review the Page Cache and Speed Optimization settings.
  5. Use the recommended settings as a starting point or configure individual controls.
  6. Save your settings and clear the cache so optimized pages can be rebuilt.
  7. Test important pages on desktop and mobile, especially WooCommerce product, cart, checkout, variation, and payment flows.
sections.faq:
Is Smart Speed Cache Accelerator™ safe for WooCommerce stores?

The plugin includes built-in WooCommerce protections for cart, checkout, account, AJAX, payment gateways, Add to Cart, galleries, variations, and other critical shopping behavior. Because themes and plugin combinations vary, test important store pages after changing advanced performance settings.

Does image optimization automatically change every image?

No. The large-image tool requires you to select the supported images you want to optimize. Responsive Image Delivery changes browser delivery hints and does not automatically replace your Media Library originals.

What happens before a selected large image is optimized?

For supported images, Smart Speed saves a downloadable original snapshot before optimization so you have an additional backup available.

Does the Heavy Plugin Analyzer tell me which plugin is slow?

No. It reports installed plugin file size as a review aid. A large plugin can still be fast, and a small plugin can still load expensive CSS or JavaScript.

Does Smart Speed automatically remove inactive plugins?

No. Inactive plugins are shown for review only. Deletion requires you to select the plugin and confirm the action.

Does the plugin automatically replace my website logo?

No. Logo LCP Helper™ creates downloadable copies only. It does not automatically edit, upload, or replace the live WordPress logo.

Does Smart Speed include Google PageSpeed testing?

Smart PageSpeed Tester™ provides a quick way to open a public Google PageSpeed Insights test for the homepage. The plugin also includes guidance for common PageSpeed and LCP issues.

Should I enable every advanced optimization setting?

Not necessarily. Recommended settings are intended as a safer starting point. Advanced CSS or JavaScript changes should be tested with your theme, plugins, forms, menus, galleries, WooCommerce pages, and payment methods.

Does the plugin require PRO to work?

No. The free plugin is functional on its own and does not require a PRO license.

short_description: Lightweight WordPress caching, responsive image delivery, CSS and JavaScript optimization, WooCommerce protections, and practical performance tools.
description:
Smart Speed Cache Accelerator™ is a WordPress and WooCommerce performance optimization plugin that brings caching, image delivery, CSS, JavaScript, fonts, WooCommerce safeguards, and performance diagnostics together in one easy-to-use dashboard.

Cache Faster. Optimize Smarter. Improve WordPress Performance.

A slow WordPress website can be affected by many things at once: page generation, large images, render-blocking CSS, unnecessary scripts, fonts, third-party resources, and heavy plugins. Smart Speed Cache Accelerator™ provides practical tools to work on those problems instead of only reporting that they exist.

The plugin uses clearly labeled optimization sections, Recommended ON/OFF guidance, conservative defaults, and built-in WooCommerce protections so website owners can improve performance without blindly applying aggressive changes.

Video Tutorial

See Smart Speed Cache Accelerator™ in action and take a guided tour of the caching, image, CSS, JavaScript, WooCommerce, diagnostic, and performance tools.

Watch on YouTube:
https://youtu.be/zrDFyxMu5p0

Smart Cache Engine™

Features include:

  • Page caching
  • Adjustable cache lifetime
  • Cache clearing and cache testing
  • Automatic cache invalidation
  • Content-update cache clearing
  • WooCommerce-aware cache handling
  • Logged-in user protection
  • Query-string controls
  • 404 cache controls
  • Custom cache exclusions
  • Cache hit and miss statistics
  • Cache size and last-build information

Smart Cache Status™

The dashboard shows useful cache information including cache working status, pages cached, cache size, cache hits, cache misses, last cache build, and active optimizations.

Quick Actions make it easy to Clear Cache or Test Cache Now directly from the dashboard.

Smart Responsive Image Delivery

Improve how existing WordPress responsive images are delivered without automatically replacing Media Library originals.

Features include:

  • Responsive image delivery using existing WordPress image candidates
  • WordPress srcset support
  • Smarter image sizes guidance
  • WooCommerce product-grid image sizing
  • LCP and hero responsive delivery
  • Image lazy loading
  • Iframe lazy loading
  • Missing width and height improvements
  • Above-the-fold image protection
  • LCP image prioritization
  • Fetch priority support

Optimize Large Images™

Review unusually large images before deciding whether to optimize them. Nothing is optimized simply because it was detected.

Selected supported images can be resized to a maximum of 1600×1600 and recompressed. Before optimization, Smart Speed saves a downloadable snapshot of the original image for additional safety.

Smart Asset Delivery™

Optimize eligible local CSS and shared front-end assets without combining everything into one oversized file.

Smart Asset Delivery™ can:

  • Cache and minify eligible local CSS
  • Create reusable optimized CSS copies
  • Preserve relative image and font paths
  • Remove exact duplicate CSS requests
  • Remove exact duplicate JavaScript requests
  • Detect useful external asset origins
  • Add useful external preconnect hints
  • Avoid redundant same-origin preconnect hints

Dynamic CSS, imported styles, admin/editor assets, and configured exclusions remain protected.

Safe Render-Blocking Controls™

Use a conservative CSS delivery system to defer only styles classified as low-risk and non-critical while keeping important styling in the normal render path.

Built-in protections cover important areas such as:

  • Theme layout and navigation
  • Headers
  • WooCommerce core styling
  • Product pages
  • Cart and checkout
  • Customer accounts
  • Payment gateways
  • Product galleries and variations
  • Ratings
  • jQuery and WooCommerce core behavior

JavaScript Optimization

Reduce JavaScript work during the initial page load with conservative controls and built-in protections for important WordPress and WooCommerce functionality.

Protected areas include jQuery, WooCommerce cart and checkout behavior, account and AJAX functions, payment gateways, forms, galleries, variations, and other critical shopping scripts.

Font & Front-End Optimization™

Improve text rendering and remove optional WordPress front-end resources when appropriate.

Controls include:

  • Optimize font loading
  • font-display: swap
  • Optimize external font connections
  • Remove WordPress emoji scripts
  • Remove WordPress embed scripts

WooCommerce Performance Optimization™

Reduce specifically identified non-critical WooCommerce product-page assets while protecting visible payment controls and essential shopping behavior.

Smart Speed can remove known unused payment and express-checkout assets on product pages only when no matching visible express-payment control is present.

Cart, checkout, account, Add to Cart, galleries, variations, AJAX, and visible payment controls remain protected.

WooCommerce Above-the-Fold Optimization™

Prioritize important WooCommerce product-page content for faster rendering while preserving the theme, product layout, and shopping controls.

Controls include:

  • Prioritize product title
  • Prioritize product price
  • Protect Add to Cart layout
  • Protect rating stars
  • Optional compact breadcrumbs for LCP testing
  • Conservative above-the-fold detection
  • Safe critical CSS generation for detected structural components

Critical CSS is intentionally conservative and does not copy or override theme colors, typography, WooCommerce grid sizing, or visual design.

Built-in WooCommerce Protections

Smart Speed Cache Accelerator™ is designed to avoid treating an online store like a static website.

Built-in safeguards help protect:

  • Add to Cart
  • Cart fragments
  • Cart and checkout
  • My Account
  • WooCommerce AJAX
  • Payment gateways
  • Product galleries
  • Product variations
  • Rating and review layouts
  • Navigation and header styling
  • Critical WooCommerce scripts and styles

Smart Speed Quick Wins™

Review practical performance opportunities without turning diagnostic information into made-up speed scores.

Tools include:

  • Optimize Large Images™
  • Review Inactive Plugins™
  • Heavy Plugin Analyzer™
  • Image and plugin review information

Nothing is deleted automatically. You choose which supported images to optimize and which inactive plugins, if any, to remove.

Heavy Plugin Analyzer™

Review the installed file size of active plugins that may deserve a closer performance check.

Installed plugin size alone does not mean a plugin is slowing down a website, so the report is presented as a review tool rather than a speed ranking.

Original Image Snapshot Protection

When supported large images are optimized, Smart Speed can save a downloadable copy of the original first. Snapshot files provide an additional recovery option and are not used to silently replace your live images.

Export Center™

Export useful information for later review, including:

  • Performance Report CSV
  • Cache Statistics CSV

PageSpeed & LCP Helpers

Smart Speed includes practical guidance and tools for common Google PageSpeed situations.

  • Smart PageSpeed Tester™ opens a public Google PageSpeed test for your homepage.
  • Breadcrumb LCP guidance helps when WooCommerce breadcrumbs are reported as the Largest Contentful Paint element.
  • Logo LCP Helper™ can create safe downloadable desktop and mobile logo copies from the current WordPress custom logo.
  • Generated logo copies are never automatically uploaded or substituted for the live logo.

Recommended Settings Without the Guesswork

Optimization groups explain what each control does and identify recommended, optional, or advanced settings where appropriate.

The dashboard includes Apply Recommended Settings, Save Settings, and Restore Recommended Settings controls so users have a sensible starting point while retaining individual control.

Lightweight by Design

Smart Speed Cache Accelerator™ is built around targeted optimization rather than adding unnecessary front-end libraries.

  • No unnecessary frontend libraries
  • Admin-focused dashboard assets
  • Targeted cache invalidation
  • Reusable optimized asset files
  • Conservative CSS handling
  • Controlled JavaScript optimization
  • WordPress-native responsive image support
  • WooCommerce protections
  • No fake performance scores
  • No made-up optimization statistics

Upgrade to PRO

Smart Speed Cache Accelerator PRO™ expands the performance toolkit with additional advanced optimization and performance features for users who want deeper control.

Learn more:
https://smartproductseo.com/product/smart-speed-cache-accelerator-pro-website-performance/
